name: TikTok Streak Auto-Saver & Helper Hub
changelog: ⏰ Fixed LaunchAgent scheduler to trigger strictly once per day (09:00) without 15-hour loop retries

🎯 Strict DM contact uniqueId and exact name verification to prevent matching collisions
👤 Multi-account support with isolated state and per-account streak tracking
